title: Davie School Building Trades for $16M in Week's Top Commercial Deal
summary: A ~46,000 SF school building at 3367 North University Drive in Davie sold for $16 million to lead South Florida's recorded commercial deals for the week, while a Pinecrest home at 5865 SW 96th Street topped residential at $7.8 million and a newly built Boca Raton home traded at about $1,200 per square foot.

title: Mortgage Rates Hit Seven-Week Low: 30-Yr Fixed at 6.43%, Jumbo 6.60%
summary: Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed averaged 6.43% the week of July 2, down from 6.49% and well below the 6.67% of a year ago, with the 15-year at 5.79%. Bankrate's 30-year jumbo average eased to 6.60% - a friendlier financing backdrop for SE Florida buyers heading into summer.

title: Bal Harbour Shops Expansion, Pinnacle Affordable Project Lead Top Permits
summary: The week's largest new building permit was an $11.8 million filing for Pinnacle's two-building Pinnacle at Cypress affordable-housing development at 6520 North Andrews Avenue in Fort Lauderdale, while Bal Harbour Shops' luxury retail expansion also ranked among South Florida's top construction permits.

title: Florida Insurance Rate Cuts Take Effect July 1: Citizens -8.7% Statewide, SE FL Counties ~-14%
summary: Florida OIR-approved homeowners rate decreases took effect July 1 for new policies (and at renewal for existing ones). Citizens' average statewide decrease is about 8.7% - with Miami-Dade and Broward seeing cuts near 14% - while private carriers including State Farm (-10.1%) continue filing reductions. More than 15 new insurers have entered since the 2022-23 reforms.

title: Palm Beach $21M Sale Leads South Florida's Top Deals into July
summary: A ~6,000 SF Palm Beach home at 242 Wells Road traded for $21 million to lead the week's residential deals, joined by a $15.25M Jupiter Inlet beachfront closing, a $13.2M Lighthouse Point waterfront sale and a $10.5M La Gorce Circle sale in Miami Beach - the eight-figure market stayed busy straight into the summer.

title: Investor Lists $138M in Trophy Penthouses, Including $78M Miami Beach Unit
summary: Investor William Duker put two penthouses on the market for a combined $138 million - including a three-story unit at Miami Beach's Apogee at 800 South Pointe Drive asking $78 million, which would rank among the priciest condo listings in South Florida.

title: Florida Property-Insurance Cat Reinsurance Prices Fall 15-20% at June Renewals
summary: Guy Carpenter reports risk-adjusted Florida property-catastrophe reinsurance pricing down roughly 15-20% across many layers at the June 2026 renewals, easing a key cost driver for coastal-property carriers and, in turn, homeowner premiums.

title: Viceroy Brickell Completes as Villa Miami Climbs - Condo Pipeline Milestones
summary: The 45-story Viceroy Brickell - the brand's first fully residential tower - completed construction and is welcoming its first owners, while Villa Miami reached its 37th floor and The Residences at Mandarin Oriental opened its North Tower sales gallery.

title: Is South Florida's Branded-Condo Boom Reaching Its Limit?
summary: The Real Deal's June magazine examines growing saturation in South Florida's branded-condo market, where dozens of hotel- and designer-branded towers have turned a premium differentiator into the new normal - sharpening the focus on location and developer track record.

title: Waterfront Estate of Palm Beach's Oldest Resident Trades for $35M
summary: The 6,700 SF waterfront home at 350 Island Road - residence of Palm Beach's oldest resident for over six decades - sold for $35 million in an apparent all-cash deal, months after listing at $41 million. Island trophy product keeps clearing at scale even off peak ask.

title: Dezer Pivots to Broader Market With ~600-Unit North Miami Rental Project
summary: Dezer Development, long known for ultra-luxury branded condos, is planning nearly 600 market-rate apartments in North Miami - a notable signal that big South Florida developers see the deepest demand in attainable rental product.

title: Broward Beach Resort Headed to July 16 Foreclosure Auction Over $40M Debt
summary: The Hillsboro Beach Resort at 1159 Hillsboro Mile - a former Sonder property - is set for a July 16 foreclosure auction following a $26 million loan default, a reminder that pockets of hospitality distress persist even in a strong coastal market.

title: Colliers: South Florida Multifamily Cap Rates Hold Near 5.0%
summary: Colliers' Q1 2026 South Florida multifamily report shows cap rates steady near 5.0% as elevated insurance and operating costs shape pricing. Miami's vacancy is the lowest among major Florida metros at 6.6%, versus Orlando 7.3%, Tampa 8.8% and Jacksonville 12.2%.

title: Miami-Dade Home Sales Rise for Ninth Straight Month; SF Median at $680K
summary: May 2026 stats from MIAMI Realtors show total Miami-Dade home sales up 7.9% year-over-year - the ninth consecutive monthly gain - with $1M+ sales up 14.7% and the single-family median at $680,000 (+0.7%). Condo inventory fell 8.9%, its fourth straight monthly decline.

title: SE Florida Home Sales Up Year-Over-Year for Consecutive Spring Months
summary: Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach each posted higher total home sales year-over-year across consecutive spring months, signaling sustained tri-county momentum even as pricing cools from recent highs.

title: Palm Beach County Average Sale Price Climbs 11% YTD to $1.025M
summary: Palm Beach County's average sale price rose 11% year-to-date from $924,000 to just over $1,025,000, with the median up 3% to $518,500. An unusually high share of cash closings underscores that liquidity, not leverage, is setting the pace.
